definitions.explanation: an event, activity, or service that continues throughout the night until morning

examples.japanese: オールナイトで{映画|えいが}を{見|み}た。
カラオケでオールナイトをした。
examples.english: We did an all-night session at karaoke.

examples.japanese: オールナイトの{上映会|じょうえいかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I participated in an all-night screening event.

notes:
LOANWORD:
From English "all night"

COMMON USES:
- オールナイト{営業|えいぎょう} - all-night business operation
- オールナイト{上映|じょうえい} - all-night movie screening
- オールナイトで - all night (adverbial use)

CULTURE:
All-night events are popular in Japan, especially:
- カラオケ (karaoke) - many karaoke establishments offer all-night packages
- ネットカフェ (internet cafes) - popular for overnight stays
- {映画館|えいがかん} (movie theaters) - special all-night screening events

RELATED:
- {徹夜|てつや} - staying up all night (native Japanese word)
- {夜通|よどお}し - all through the night
